product: Demand is led by Jakafi/Jakafi XR (ruxolitinib) in myelofibrosis, polycythemia vera and GVHD, at 817M net sales in Q2 2026, and Opzelura cream in vitiligo and atopic dermatitis at 450M (204M ex-one-time). Niktimvo, Monjuvi/Minjuvi and Zynyz add portfolio growth (2026-07-28, 8-K EX-99.1).
demand: Growth is volume/demand-led. Q2 2026 net sales rose 40 percent (17 percent ex-one-time) on increased demand across marketed products: Jakafi plus 7 percent, Opzelura plus 24 percent ex-one-time, Hematology/Oncology plus 69 percent. Price/GTN added only modestly, with the CMS settlement expected to add 40-50M in H2 2026 (2026-07-28).
pricing_power: Jakafi loss of exclusivity or early generic entry, gross-to-net erosion, and failed pipeline readouts would compress margins. Q3 2026 also carries a roughly 1,270M Vega IPR&D charge, and FY26 opex guidance was raised to 4,915-4,995M GAAP. Q2 cost of sales was only 7 percent of net sales, so the pressure is revenue and opex driven (2026-07-28).
competition: Not found as a specific dated product in primary sources (2026-09-27). The structural low-cost substitute is generic ruxolitinib after Jakafi exclusivity ends; no Chinese or other substitute, and no timing or price, was disclosed in the filings or IR material read.
market_strategy: CEO Bill Meury, 2026-07-28 Q2 press release: With ten data readouts expected in the second half of 2026, alongside product launches through early next year, we are well positioned for our next phase of growth. The same release guided FY26 total net sales of 5,130-5,260M and Opzelura of 1,050-1,100M (8-K EX-99.1).
bull: Q2 2026 net sales rose 40% (17% ex-one-time) on volume; FY26 guidance raised to $5,130-5,260M and Opzelura to $1,050-1,100M; FDA approved Atebrioz 2026-09-25; 13 raises vs 0 lowers in 90 days.
bear: Engine shows revenue QoQ -15.5% and flat gross margin; Jakafi faces loss of exclusivity with FY26 guide only $3,220-3,270M; Q3 2026 carries ~$1,270M Vega IPR&D charge; RBC maintains Sector Perform at $109.
falsifier: Q3 2026 report (late Oct/early Nov 2026) cutting FY26 total net sales below $5,130M or Opzelura below $1,050M, or Jakafi net sales below the $3,220-3,270M guide.
web_what_changed_30_90d: Last 30 days: FDA approved Atebrioz (zilurgisertib) for FOP, licensed to Mirum, 2026-09-25 (IR PR); EADV Congress data announced 2026-09-22 (IR PR). Last 90 days: 2026-08-31 CMS 8-K on Jakafi Medicaid pricing; 2026-07-28 Q2 results that raised FY26 guidance; Opzelura EU approval 2026-07-29; Vega acquisition closed 2026-07-06.
web_true_now_not_modelled: FY26 guidance (2026-07-28) now embeds a one-time 246M non-cash CMS accrual reversal in Opzelura plus a roughly 1,270M Vega IPR&D charge landing in Q3 2026 GAAP results. Q2 total net sales rose 40 percent but only 17 percent excluding that one-time item, so headline growth and EPS can mislead models (8-K EX-99.1).
web_demand_product: Demand is led by Jakafi/Jakafi XR (ruxolitinib) in myelofibrosis, polycythemia vera and GVHD, at 817M net sales in Q2 2026, and Opzelura cream in vitiligo and atopic dermatitis at 450M (204M ex-one-time). Niktimvo, Monjuvi/Minjuvi and Zynyz add portfolio growth (2026-07-28, 8-K EX-99.1).
web_price_volume_mix: Growth is volume/demand-led. Q2 2026 net sales rose 40 percent (17 percent ex-one-time) on increased demand across marketed products: Jakafi plus 7 percent, Opzelura plus 24 percent ex-one-time, Hematology/Oncology plus 69 percent. Price/GTN added only modestly, with the CMS settlement expected to add 40-50M in H2 2026 (2026-07-28).
web_bottleneck: Incyte's own bottleneck is replacing flat Jakafi revenue, guided 3,220-3,270M for FY26, ahead of loss of exclusivity, plus converting ten H2 2026 readouts into approvals. What it relieves is the shortfall of effective targeted options in myelofibrosis, polycythemia vera, GVHD, vitiligo and FOP (2026-07-28, 2026-09-25).
web_who_benefits_next: Partners and counterparties benefit: Mirum Pharmaceuticals for Atebrioz in FOP (2026-09-25); Specialised Therapeutics for Opzelura in Australia (2026-09-20) and Minjuvi on Australia PBS (2026-08-01); Halozyme for ENHANZE subcutaneous INCA033989 (2026-07-20); Vega/Star Therapeutics as sellers (2026-07-06). All aggregator or IR sourced.
web_who_loses: Rival JAK and hematology competitors lose share to Jakafi XR and Opzelura, and future generic ruxolitinib entrants face a weaker pricing path because the 2026-08-31 CMS agreement lets state Medicaid buy Jakafi and Jakafi XR at international reference prices and shields Incyte from the proposed GUARD and GLOBE models (2026-08-31, 8-K item 8.01).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Jakafi loss of exclusivity or early generic entry, gross-to-net erosion, and failed pipeline readouts would compress margins. Q3 2026 also carries a roughly 1,270M Vega IPR&D charge, and FY26 opex guidance was raised to 4,915-4,995M GAAP. Q2 cost of sales was only 7 percent of net sales, so the pressure is revenue and opex driven (2026-07-28).
web_low_cost_substitute: Not found as a specific dated product in primary sources (2026-09-27). The structural low-cost substitute is generic ruxolitinib after Jakafi exclusivity ends; no Chinese or other substitute, and no timing or price, was disclosed in the filings or IR material read.
web_ceo_promised: CEO Bill Meury, 2026-07-28 Q2 press release: With ten data readouts expected in the second half of 2026, alongside product launches through early next year, we are well positioned for our next phase of growth. The same release guided FY26 total net sales of 5,130-5,260M and Opzelura of 1,050-1,100M (8-K EX-99.1).
web_did_they_deliver: Yes so far. Opzelura FY26 guidance of 750-790M issued 2026-02-10 was raised to 1,050-1,100M on 2026-07-28, and total net sales guidance rose to 5,130-5,260M. Jakafi XR was approved by FDA in May 2026 as planned. Remaining H2 2026 readouts and the Q1 2027 Monjuvi launch are still open (8-K EX-99.1).
web_what_would_falsify: A Q3 2026 report, expected around late October to early November 2026, that cuts FY26 total net sales below 5,130M or Opzelura below 1,050M; Jakafi net sales falling against the 3,220-3,270M guide; or failure of any of the four H2 2026 registrational readouts would falsify the growth thesis (2026-07-28, 8-K EX-99.1).
